title: Elements Ui Icon Selector Board Play
description: Add @elements/ui IconSelector for board icon strings ($ math, data: mime, emoji, raw vector). File picker + previews. Wire into board play Detail inspector (node + handle iconKind). Export classify helper from @elements/board + Vitest.
summary: Added `IconSelector` in `@elements/ui` with Math/Data/Emoji/Vector tabs, live preview, file import, Clear, and optional `classifyElementsBoardIconSelectorMode` hook. Exported `classifyElementsBoardIconSelectorMode` + `ElementsBoardIconSelectorMode` from `@elements/board` with Vitest coverage; refreshed `iconKind` docstrings. Wired selector into board play `InspectorNodeBatch` and `InspectorHandleBatch` with mixed-selection handling.
